summary: RenewCrewLease typed refusals and what the Crew does with each.

provisional.why: Refusal names are not fixed by the backend team yet.
The wire envelope, HTTP status and timestamp format follow the backend service's protocol, which the backend team sets. The fixture fixes the fields and codes.

planPosition: Every name here other than REMOTE_ACCESS_DISABLED and IDENTITY_IN_USE, which the HLD names, and the HTTP statuses.

refusals.when: The organization does not allow remote access. No token.
refusals.callerDoes: Stop connecting. Show the reason in Settings. Try again on the next sign-in or setting change, and at most every 15 minutes.

error.message: The organization does not allow remote access. No token.

refusals.when: A team Crew's lease is held by a different instance and is still live.
refusals.callerDoes: Don't connect. Wait retryAfterSeconds, the time until a takeover is allowed, then renew. The host shows identity in use.

error.message: A team Crew's lease is held by a different instance and is still live.

refusals.when: relay.endpointId is not the one Kiro derives for this caller and instance.
refusals.callerDoes: Drop the stored endpointId and renew without it.

error.message: relay.endpointId is not the one Kiro derives for this caller and instance.

refusals.when: This sign-in cannot host a personal Crew, for example an API key or an external IdP sign-in.
refusals.callerDoes: Stop. Settings says why Remote Control is off.

error.message: This sign-in cannot host a personal Crew, for example an API key or an external IdP sign-in.

refusals.when: The team Crew's Crew Identity is disabled or deleted, or its key was rotated.
refusals.callerDoes: Stop. Show the reason. The host connection closes when its token expires.

error.message: The team Crew's Crew Identity is disabled or deleted, or its key was rotated.

refusals.when: protocolVersion is below the relay's minimum.
refusals.callerDoes: Stop. Say an upgrade is needed.

error.message: protocolVersion is below the relay's minimum.

refusals.when: Too many calls for this caller.

error.message: Too many calls for this caller.

refusals.when: The Crew's own credential was refused.
refusals.callerDoes: Refresh the sign-in or key. A personal Crew asks the owner to sign in again.

error.message: The Crew's own credential was refused.
